chronicleSignature.description: ES256 cryptographic signature proving record authenticity. The signature itself proves legitimacy - no separate verification lexicons needed.

kid.description: Key identifier for the signing key

nonce.description: Unique random nonce to prevent replay

main.description: Signed quest completion record. rkey is the quest ID (e.g. 'first-post', 'make-camp'). Created once with createRecord when the quest is completed. Immutable.

createdAt.description: When the quest record was created

questId.description: Unique identifier for the quest (e.g. 'first-post'). Matches the record's rkey.

retroactive.description: Whether the quest was completed retroactively from existing activity rather than live

track.description: Quest track this quest belongs to (e.g. 'field-basics', 'observatory', 'expedition', 'craft')

xpAwarded.description: XP awarded for completing this quest

questContext.description: Contextual data at the time of quest completion

appMode.description: App mode ('story' or 'open') when the quest was completed

level.description: Player level when the quest was completed

totalXP.description: Total XP when the quest was completed
